reason: Successfully tested agent chat functionality by sending a math question and verifying the agent responded with the correct answer "4".
steps: Navigated to http://localhost:47891 — Page loaded successfully showing the Gamut application with sidebar containing two agents.
Found and clicked on the "QA-20260828-235934-884n" agent in the sidebar — Successfully navigated to the agent's home page; agent status displayed as "idle".
Verified agent status is "running" or "idle" — Agent status confirmed as "idle" which meets the requirement.
Clicked on the message input field — Input field became active and ready for text entry.
Typed the message "Hello! What is 2+2?" — Message successfully typed into the input field.
Clicked the Send button — Message was sent; a new session titled "Basic Math Question" was created and the page navigated to the chat view.
Waited for agent response (up to 3 minutes) — Agent responded with "4" within seconds.
Verified response mentions "4" — Response confirmed to contain "4", the correct answer to 2+2.
Took screenshot of the response — Screenshot captured successfully showing the complete conversation with user message and agent response.
